Spanish PM Pedro Sánchez:
Milei, Trump, Bolsonaro, Orbán — they all belong to the same international far-right movement, which, incidentally, is also financed by tech oligarchs like Elon Musk.
Ultimately, what they all want is to turn Spain into their colony.
We are not going to allow this country to become a colony of tech oligarchs or an international far-right movement acting against the interests of the Spanish people.
I am very clear: Spain is a sovereign country. Spain will not be governed from any capital other than Madrid.
